tagline: ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! names drop three days before debut, Kuzuha steps into a dubbing booth for the first time, VeXpo wraps at NEC Birmingham — and the OdeHolo clock is down to hours.
inThisIssue: ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! confirmed: Hyakuto Kyoko, Achichi Mela, Suzuna Tsuzuri, Sorashina Sopia — debut streams September 24-25
Kuzuha voices Marvin in the Street Fighter film Japanese dub — first professional voice-acting credit outside VTubing
VeXpo 2026 wraps at NEC Birmingham: Dokibird headlined Friday night, 2,200 in attendance across three days

lead.title: Names, faces, and a laundromat: ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI!'s four members confirmed — Hyakuto Kyoko, Achichi Mela, Suzuna Tsuzuri, Sorashina Sopia debut in three days
lead.body: After two weeks of silhouette threads and trainee-attribution guessing, Cover Corporation released the full ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! lineup on September 18. The four members are Hyakuto Kyoko (police concept, @hyakuto_kyoko), Achichi Mela (firefighter concept, @achichi_mela), Suzuna Tsuzuri (postal/delivery concept, @suzuna_tsuzuri), and Sorashina Sopia (antenna/broadcast concept, @sorashina_sopia). Their unit premise centers on a laundromat on the town's edge — four public-service-adjacent workers who converge there and decide the best extraordinary experiences start with the question 'this sounds fun?' Individual debut streams begin September 24 at 19:00 JST (Day 1) and September 25 at 19:00 JST (Day 2), each member streaming on their own channel. ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! is hololive's first new unit in approximately two years, announced as part of the September 7 hololive Next broadcast alongside the OdeHolo TV anime and the global branch consolidation. The silhouette count on the original teaser was correct: four. Debut is in three days.

stories.title: The OdeHolo Reveal Special airs tomorrow at 20:00 JST — full title, key visual, and story details for hololive's first TV anime after five years in development
stories.blurb: The OdeHolo Information Reveal Program streams September 23 at 20:00 JST on the official anime YouTube channel, hosted by Momosuzu Nene, Omaru Polka, Yukihana Lamy, and Shishiro Botan with Shirakami Fubuki and Ookami Mio as MCs. Everything held back since the September 7 announcement — the actual title, the story, the key visual, likely the full cast — drops in the one-hour broadcast. The working title OdeHolo has generated more active speculation threads than any hololive announcement since the Suisei arena tour reveal. September 23 is a National Holiday in Japan. The reveal is in roughly 24 hours.

stories.title: Kuzuha cast as Marvin in the Street Fighter (2026) Japanese theatrical dub — first professional voice-acting credit for one of Nijisanji's biggest names
stories.blurb: Kuzuha of NIJISANJI will voice Marvin — a supporting character original to the 2026 Street Fighter film — in its Japanese theatrical dub. The announcement, part of the second wave voice cast reveal for the film, marks Kuzuha's first professional credit outside VTubing. A major agency VTuber landing a theatrical film dub role in the same week that agency's EN branch shortlists a new generation is the kind of week ANYCOLOR shareholders notice. The Street Fighter (2026) film is scheduled for Japanese theatrical release later this year. The role is minor, the precedent is not.

stories.title: VeXpo 2026 closes at NEC Birmingham: Dokibird headlined the opening night, 2,200 attended, and every metric cleared the 2024 high
stories.blurb: VeXpo 2026 concluded September 20 after three days at the National Exhibition Centre in Birmingham. Friday's opening concert ran 8-11PM on the Monarch Stage — Dokibird and Dooby headlining, with rachie, ChromaSHIFT, Akugaki Koa, Glitch Stars, Linvy, Lilith O'Leerie, and Skye Senfort across the bill. The hololive English -All For One- 3rd concert screened during Saturday programming. Attendance finished around 2,200 — up 110 percent from 2024 — with 120 guests from UK, EU, and North America. VeXpo's three-year arc from small venue to medium to NEC Birmingham is complete. Recap content is out on attendee accounts.

stories.title: Week 16: Filian is still DEBUT DELAYED — the Phase Saga one-year anniversary is October 25, four and a half weeks out
stories.blurb: September 21 is sixteen weeks since the @Filian_VT1 countdown reached zero and the account updated to DEBUT DELAYED. Phase Connect's Phase Saga generation — Clio Aite, Mari Mari, Eepy Sleepy — marks one year on October 25. No announcement from Phase Connect. The October 25 thread on /vt/ is still the board's most active non-drama general, now featuring an annotated Pippa timestamp doc with 400-plus entries scored by estimated deliberate-signal probability. Pippa has not confirmed or denied anything. Four and a half weeks to October 25.

stories.title: nijiFAN Talk vol.6 begins Friday September 26 — and the immersion-focused male audition shortlist contact window closes this week
stories.blurb: NIJISANJI EN's nijiFAN Talk vol.6 community event runs September 26-27 and October 3-4. The Immersion-Focused: Male VTuber Audition closed applications August 29; the 'approximately one month' shortlist contact window resolves this week, placing it between September 21 and 29. No shortlist confirmations have been made public. nijiFAN Talk has historically coincided with new wave activity, and the community is reading the October 3-4 continuation weekend as a potential announcement window. The ongoing board debate about what 'immersion-focused' means for an EN debut is still the most-discussed Nijisanji EN topic that isn't drama. This week starts the answer window.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: VeXpo closed with an indie at the top of the bill for the second year running — Dokibird headlined NEC Birmingham's opening night
indies.blurb: For the second consecutive year, VeXpo placed an independent creator above agency talent in its headline slot. Dokibird closed Friday night's opening concert on the Monarch Stage in front of approximately 2,200 attendees — NEC Birmingham is the largest room VeXpo has ever staged. The bill also featured Linvy, Lilith O'Leerie, and Skye Senfort alongside agency-affiliated guests. Convention programmers answer the headlining question with commercial calculation. VeXpo's calculation for a second consecutive year is a creator without a label.

indies.title: Fifteen months post-VShojo: the top-tier English indie scene is still not moving to agencies, and the convention footprint keeps expanding
indies.blurb: Fifteen months after VShojo's shutdown, none of the consistently cited English indie top tier — Dokibird, Shylily, Mint Fantome, Akuma Nihmune, Bao, Matara Kan — has announced an agency affiliation. Individual creator infrastructure now handles merch, scheduling, and event bookings at mid-tier agency scale. VeXpo headlining and European convention slots are indie territory. The predicted post-VShojo migration to agencies has not arrived. Fifteen months of data says the trend is running the other direction.

indies.title: The post-VeXpo debut window closes Friday — September's launch class wraps Q3 with four competing attention anchors hitting the same two-week stretch
indies.blurb: The post-convention viewer attention spike typically runs about a week — VeXpo pulls broader audience awareness onto the scene and indie creators launching in its wake pick up a short-lived discovery window. The September debut window, a named strategy in debut-tracking communities for at least two years, closes this Friday. The Q4 calendar then opens immediately: the OdeHolo reveal, the ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! debuts, nijiFAN Talk vol.6, and the Phase Saga anniversary countdown all land in the same two-week stretch. Tracking active at hololist.net.

tea.text: ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! dropped four names and the board produced three competing lore theories within the hour. Theory one: the laundromat is a callback to a 2022 Cover internal presentation describing a 'neighborhood connector' unit concept that never shipped — someone still has the original slide allegedly screenshotted from a design leak and says the layout matches. Theory two: Hyakuto Kyoko's police motif plus Achichi Mela's firefighter motif means two of the four members are legally obligated to have enemy-coded dynamic content, and this unit will generate more horizontal-collab drama than any hololive unit since Holostars EN. Minority theory three: the laundromat is purely aesthetic, the concept is just 'play-first public servants,' and everyone is massively overcooking this. Debut is in three days. The cooking continues until at minimum Day 2.

The OdeHolo title board resolved to two finalists with less than 24 hours on the clock: Odekake Hololive (day-trip, travel-comedy read — held the plurality all week) versus Ode wo Utaou Hololive (let's sing an ode — music-spine read, late surge from the idol-anime logic camp). The designated thread referee ruled that Odekake wins on sound, Ode wo Utaou wins on thematic coherence, and the NENE/POLKA/LAMY/BOTAN reveal lineup still reads as a party-adventure front four to everyone who has ever played an RPG. The reveal is a National Holiday. The board will be absolutely unhinged tomorrow night. Make plans.

The Filian timestamp prophecy doc hit 400 entries and the compilers added a Bayes annotation layer — entries are now scored by estimated deliberate-signal probability versus standard Pippa-bit behavior. The top-ranked entry is a July 14 stream timestamp where Pippa recited a number string that, per the annotation, resolves to October 25, 2026. The counter-camp position is unchanged: Pippa does the spoiler bit on every stream, October 25 appears in any long enough random sample, and the doc is a selection-bias engine with good UI. Both camps agree the actual variable is what Phase Connect does or doesn't announce in the next four weeks. Neither the Bayes scores nor the counter-camp's methodology changes that. October 25 is the date.

The Kuzuha Street Fighter casting opened the 'VTuber dubbing roles' nomination thread for the fourth time this year. Consensus top picks for the next casting: Kenmochi Touya (has stage credits, the board treats this as an obvious pipeline), Marine (nominated for every role regardless of logic, now at 60 upvotes across three separate nomination threads, nobody explains the reasoning), and Matsuri for a villain in whatever film comes next, sitting at 45 upvotes with zero coherent justification. The meta-joke is that Marine would accept any casting immediately and over-deliver regardless of preparation time, and half the nominations are based on that premise. Kuzuha's credit goes to theaters later this year. The thread is still running.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 28 September — by then OdeHolo will have its real name (reveal is tomorrow night at 20:00 JST), ASOBI★MAWARI-TAI! will have debuted across four streams over two days, nijiFAN Talk vol.6 will be one weekend in, and the Phase Saga anniversary clock sits at four weeks. See you in seven.
